Smile Makeovers: What Procedures Are Involved?

Dr. Viddulata Jagtap

Senior Dentist

April 10, 2025

Do you ever hide your smile in photos?

It’s a common story. I meet patients at Shriyan Dental Clinic who are successful and confident in every area of their life—except one. When the camera comes out, their lips stay sealed.

Maybe you have a chipped front tooth. Maybe there’s a gap that has always bothered you. Or perhaps your teeth have yellowed over the years.

A Smile Makeover isn't a single procedure; it is a custom treatment plan designed to address all these issues at once. Think of it as architecture for your face. We don’t just fix teeth; we design a smile that fits your face shape, gum line, and personality.


But what exactly goes into it? Here are the most common procedures we combine to create that perfect transformation.


1. Porcelain Veneers (The "Hollywood" Standard)

If you want a permanent, flawless change, Porcelain Veneers are the answer.

  • What they are: Wafer-thin shells of porcelain custom-made to fit over the front surface of your teeth.
  • What they fix: Severe discoloration, chipped teeth, gaps, and even slightly crooked teeth.
  • Why patients love them: Porcelain mimics natural tooth enamel perfectly and is stain-resistant.

Looking for Porcelain Veneers in Mundhwa? We specialize in natural-looking designs.


2. Composite Bonding (The Quick Fix)

Not everyone needs veneers. Composite bonding is a fantastic, less invasive alternative where we sculpt tooth-colored resin directly onto your tooth.

  • What it fixes: Minor chips, small gaps, or jagged edges.
  • The Benefit: Usually done in one single visit with no numbing required.

3. Teeth Whitening (The Brightener)

Almost every makeover starts here. We usually recommend whitening your other teeth first to set a brighter baseline for any restorations.


4. Gum Contouring (The Frame)

Sometimes, the problem isn't the teeth—it’s the gums. If you have a "gummy smile" or uneven gum line, we can gently reshape it using a soft-tissue laser to reveal more of your natural tooth and improve symmetry.


5. Clear Aligners (The Foundation)

If your teeth are severely crowded, we might recommend a short course of Clear Aligners first. This moves teeth into position so final cosmetic work is minimal.


The "Test Drive": Digital Smile Design

The scariest part is the unknown. "What if I don't like how it looks?" That is why we use Digital Smile Design.

Before we touch a single tooth, we design your new smile digitally. You can see exactly what the final result will look like on your own face before you commit.


Is a Smile Makeover Right for You?

A smile makeover is an investment in yourself. It’s not just about vanity; it’s about being able to laugh freely.

Let’s design your future smile. If you live in Mundhwa, Pune, come in for a cosmetic consultation. Tell us what you don't like about your smile, and we will show you what is possible.
